all: Chinese Government provides grant worth XCD 55 million for George Odlum Soccer Stadium Construction Project
Chinese Government granted $700,000 to develop a sites and services program on Agard Lands
Chinese Government provides $500,000 grant for Phase 1 of Micro-Community Projects (Linked to Project ID#54943)
